_comment: Touch keypad for the CYD, sent with {"cmd":"keypad"} by cyd_daemon.py (auto, while a watched process runs) or cyd_push.py --keypad. Keys flow left-to-right, top-to-bottom in a cols x rows grid (max 6x6, max 6 pages, 24 keys/page); "w"/"h" span cells, null leaves a gap. key = host key name or combo (esc, enter, tab, backspace, space, up/down/left/right, f1-f24, pageup, pagedown, home, end, insert, delete, win, apps, printscreen, a-z, 0-9, alt+f4, ctrl+shift+esc ...). action = next | prev | exit | page (with "page": N). mod = ctrl | shift | alt | win (tap: one-shot, tap again: locked, third tap: off). label "@up/@down/@left/@right/@next/@prev" draws an arrow; "\n" splits a label in two lines. Optional "color": "#RRGGBB". Keys starting with _ are ignored by the firmware; watch_processes is used by cyd_daemon.py only.
